lookback_notes: The assessor's observation window for Columns 2 and 3 is the 7-day look-back period (Column 2 = performed while NOT a resident and within the last 7 days; Column 3 = performed while a resident and within the last 7 days). The document states additional, column-specific windows: Column 1 assessment period is days 1 through 3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B, and Column 4 assessment period is the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending on A2400C. Column 2 is left blank if the resident was admitted/entered or reentered more than 7 days ago.
